positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Lead a team of engineers to build a product for healthcare professionals that enables them to detect a degree of burn on a victim for the NJIT senior capstone program.

Trained and guided software developers to build a product that was secure, scalable, and accurate.

Built an image classifier using Tensorflow

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android Development
- Developed and maintained the first 3 iterations of Android app with NodeJS
backend. UI included custom views all of which were designed with Material
Design.
- Created a complex UI with realtime messaging and voting system that included
push notifications, realtime UI changes. Also included an LRU cache thread for
images, local data store for caching network requests. Used Realm, Retrofit, and
Firebase.
- Used Proguard to minify codebase and obfuscate code
- Onboarded new android developers and trained engineers on the software
development lifecycle with Zenhub

iOS Development
- Helped build the second generation of the iOS application (without storyboards)
used TRON, Material design components, Firebase
